report:
Based on Microsoft's official earnings releases and SEC filings, here are the GAAP financial results for the eight fiscal quarters from December 31, 2024, through September 30, 2026.

**Q2 FY2025 (Ended December 31, 2024)**
- GAAP Revenue: $69,632 million
- GAAP Net Income: $24,074 million
- GAAP Diluted EPS: $3.23
Revenue grew 12% year-over-year, while net income increased 10% despite a $939 million reduction from OpenAI investment losses [[23]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2025-q2/press-release-webcast)[[25]](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/PressReleaseFY25Q2)[[26]](https://www.analystlens.com/stocks/msft/10q/fy2025-q2).

**Q3 FY2025 (Ended March 31, 2025)**
- GAAP Revenue: $70,073 million
- GAAP Net Income: $25,837 million
- GAAP Diluted EPS: $3.46
Revenue climbed 13% year-over-year, driven by Microsoft Cloud revenue reaching $42.4 billion [[9]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q3/press-release-webcast)[[11]](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/30/microsoft-msft-q3-earnings-report-2025.html)[[14]](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2025-4-30-microsoft-co-stock/).

**Q4 FY2025 (Ended June 30, 2025)**
- GAAP Revenue: $76,441 million
- GAAP Net Income: $27,233 million
- GAAP Diluted EPS: $3.65
This quarter marked a record for FY25, with revenue up 18% and net income up 24% on a GAAP basis [[17]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2025/07/30/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-fourth-quarter-results/)[[20]](https://www.techpowerup.com/339430/microsoft-releases-fy25-q4-earnings-report)[[58]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q4/press-release-webcast).

**Q1 FY2026 (Ended September 30, 2025)**
- GAAP Revenue: $77,672 million
- GAAP Net Income: $27,700 million
- GAAP Diluted EPS: $3.72
Revenue increased 18% year-over-year. GAAP net income rose 12% to $27.7 billion, though results were impacted by a $3.1 billion loss from OpenAI investments [[1]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q1/press-release-webcast)[[71]](https://www.adgully.com/post/8461/microsoft-posts-stellar-q1-fy26-earnings-with-18-revenue-growth-powered-by-cloud-and-ai-expansion)[[138]](https://english.news.cn/20251030/eb6c210714414422a1ccf4b0838c6d12/c.html).

**Q2 FY2026 (Ended December 31, 2025)**
- GAAP Revenue: $81,270 million
- GAAP Net Income: $38,460 million
- GAAP Diluted EPS: $5.16
Revenue grew 17%, while GAAP net income surged 60% to $38.5 billion, largely due to $7.6 billion in net gains from OpenAI investments [[29]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q2/press-release-webcast)[[31]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/01/28/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-drives-second-quarter-results-3/)[[78]](https://www.verdict.co.uk/microsoft-q2-fy26-results/).

**Q3 FY2026 (Ended March 31, 2026)**
- GAAP Revenue: $82,892 million
- GAAP Net Income: $31,800 million
- GAAP Diluted EPS: $4.27
Revenue increased 18% year-over-year, with GAAP net income climbing 23% to $31.8 billion [[51]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/press-release-webcast)[[60]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/04/29/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-third-quarter-results/)[[62]](https://www.techpowerup.com/348650/microsoft-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results).

**Q4 FY2026 (Ended June 30, 2026)**
- GAAP Revenue: $90,012 million
- GAAP Net Income: $35,800 million
- GAAP Diluted EPS: $4.81
Revenue reached $90.0 billion, up 18%, while GAAP net income increased 31% to $35.8 billion [[39]](https://www.techpowerup.com/351206/microsoft-announces-fourth-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-results)[[40]](https://www.markets.com/news/microsoft-earnings-q4-fy-2026)[[42]](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/microsoft-earnings-release-fy26-q4-ce7f51d3dd8bff25).

**Q1 FY2027 (Ended September 30, 2026)**
- GAAP Revenue: $92,279 million
- GAAP Net Income: $36,629 million
- GAAP Diluted EPS: $4.92
Revenue grew 19% to $92.3 billion, driven by 48% Azure growth. GAAP net income rose 32% to $36.6 billion [[43]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2027-Q1/press-release-webcast)[[46]](https://stockmarkethours.org/events/microsoft-earnings)[[57]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2027-Q1/press-release-webcast).

**Critical Reflection**
The data demonstrates consistent top-line growth ranging from 12% to 19% across the eight quarters, heavily fueled by cloud and AI infrastructure demand [[9]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q3/press-release-webcast)[[48]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/microsoft-msft-q1-earnings-report-2027.html). Notably, GAAP net income and diluted EPS in Q2 FY2025 and Q1 FY2026 were suppressed by OpenAI investment losses, whereas Q2 FY2026 saw a significant GAAP boost from $7.6 billion in OpenAI gains [[24]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/01/28/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-drives-second-quarter-results-3/)[[66]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q1/press-release-webcast)[[73]](https://static.poder360.com.br/2026/01/microsoft-4T25.pdf). This volatility in investment impacts highlights the importance of examining non-GAAP metrics alongside GAAP figures to understand core operational performance. All reported figures are cross-verified against Microsoft's official press releases and SEC 10-Q/10-K filings.
